appleTest.note: Stall starts Day 1 with 20 apples; ~5 sell in the morning. See ECONOMY.md section 10 for the full tick-by-tick numbers.
appleTest.reachability: Hunger (70 at wake, 6/hr), poverty (15 copper), opportunity (stall 1 min from square, Mira sometimes at the back), prior knowledge (berry-basket errands put the player at the stall before 14:00). No scripted motive; the scenario runner issues the theft as a player command.

arrival.note: Wakes on the riverbank below the Old River Shrine with memories of our world intact. Reincarnation stays secret.

firstContact.reaction: Curious, not afraid. Runs for her father. First line: 'Are you the stranger? I'm Tansy. Papa says you're to come for supper.'
Checks the stranger isn't hurt, offers water and supper at the mill house (Hearth hospitality). Reports the stranger to the guard.
Logs the report, looks the player over, asks three calm questions (name, where from, business). Thorough, not hostile.
Most of the village knows 'there's a stranger by the shrine' via Tansy, the farmgate, the well, and the tavern. Default stance: polite wariness.

food.note: Hunger 6/hr x 16h. Options: pot-wash meal, eggs (1), barley loaf (2), Mira's bruised apple (free), half-catch, foraged berries.

inventory.clothes: strange, foreign-cut, worn (not an inventory item; feeds witness descriptions)

opportunities.note: Barley won't wait; Piotr is curious and resentful in equal measure.
Hauling is the bottleneck; Brynn offers water and gossip.
Patching the cracking wheel; the village's 8,000-copper problem made tangible.
Evenings. Bessa sizes the player up; a cook is noticed by 19:00.
Autumn berries for the stall display. Puts the player at the stall before 14:00.
Herb patches regrow in 3 days; remedies 'work a little better than they should'.

opportunities.extra: keep half the catch, once trusted
opportunities.note: Trust is the wage; fish are the bonus.
Tom's old job. Small coin, large gossip.

opportunities.extra: costs 1 copper or a crust of bread
opportunities.note: The cheapest reputation in the game; the Hearth notices.

reputationStart.note: Neutral-to-cool: polite wariness. Every kindness or theft moves it from here.

skillChoice.note: Deniable framing. The village never learns the choice; only the player's actions are visible.
skillChoice.prompt: What were you good at, back then?

sleep.note: One night affordable on arrival (15 copper); two is not.
Garrick's floor by the hearth, 1-2 nights (Hearth hospitality). Then the player needs a plan.
Sleeping rough: free, cold, visible. Villagers -2, children +2 reputation.
